proposal.rationale: Reviewed the 10 undetermined sections. Chapter 103 (Right to Object / Discrimination / Remedies / Duty of Private Entities) is about abortion-related conscience protections — it applies to physicians, nurses, staff, and employees of hospitals/health care facilities generally, but the anchor text does not contain a clean universal applicability phrase or enumerated practice-act cites. These are substantive rules, not scoping statements, so they should remain undetermined for triage rather than be force-matched. Chapter 104 (Healing Art Practitioners) likewise lacks a universal applicability clause in its anchors: Section 104.001 is just a short title, 104.002 defines "healing art," 104.003–104.005 reference "a person subject to this section" and a list in Section 104.003 (the healing art licensing boards), and 104.006 is a carve-out for established churches ("This chapter does not affect..."), which is a negative scoping clause, not a positive universal one. Adding a pattern for "does not affect" or for the "healing art" definition would risk false positives elsewhere. The proper enumeration for Chapter 104 lives in Section 104.003's list of healing-art licensing boards, but that text isn't in the anchor set provided and the cites there are to board names, not chapter numbers. I am keeping the patterns as-is: better to leave these for manual review than to over-broaden. No changes.
